Senior Backend Engineer — Payments Infrastructure

We're hiring a senior backend engineer to own a critical piece of our payments stack. The team operates billions of transactions per year; reliability and correctness are non-negotiable.

What you'll do:
- Design and ship low-latency services in Go
- Own one or more critical pipelines end-to-end, including on-call
- Mentor mid-level engineers via design reviews and code review
- Work closely with finance and compliance to ship correct ledger primitives

Required:
- 5+ years of backend engineering in a typed language (Go strongly preferred; Rust / Java OK)
- Production PostgreSQL experience — schema design, query plans, replication
- Distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, ordering, fault tolerance
- Production Kubernetes — debugging, observability, custom controllers
- Strong code review and mentorship track record

Preferred:
- Payments / fintech / ledger systems experience
- Kafka or other event-streaming systems
- Open-source contributions
